ios.desc:
Introducing Teleport, the ultimate iPhone app for capturing spherical 360° panorama photos.

Teleport lets you capture your environment in stunning 360° with just your phone. Simply find a cool location, follow the prompts, and Teleport will stitch your photos together to create a seamless spherical panorama.

Explore a vast collection of immersive captures shared by the vibrant Teleport community and share your own unique moments. Plus, download the Vision Pro version of Teleport to fully immerse yourself in your 360° panorama photo and relive your memories like never before.

What once required an expensive 360° camera can now be done conveniently on your iPhone or iPad with Teleport. Whether you're capturing photos for Real Estate, Interior Design, Tourism, Travel, Art, Creative Projects, or simply for your personal memories, Teleport makes it easy and accessible.

How it works:

Download the app on your iPhone or iPad.
Capture a 360° panorama on your device.
Download the app on your Vision Pro to immerse yourself in the 360° panorama, or view it on your iPhone or iPad.

Terms of Use: https://hdreye.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hdreye.app/privacy

show_hn.title: Show HN: Teleport 360° Camera – Take 360° photos on iPhone to view on Vision Pro

quotes.text:
Hello HN!

A couple years back, a few of my VFX friends and I set out to create an iPhone app that allowed you to take 360° spherical HDRi photos to light your 3D scene (https://hdreye.app). This led us down the rabbit hole of taking a spherical photo using your iPhone. To our surprise, the only iPhone app that had allowed a user to take these types of photos was Google Street View, but had since been discontinued.

With the release of the Vision Pro later today, we believe these types of photos will hold much more value.

As a result, we’ve created Teleport: 360° Camera. Teleport allows you to take a 360° spherical photo using just your iPhone or iPad, and then view it in full immersion on your Vision Pro (or your iPhone or iPad).

We’re eager to get some initial feedback.

App page: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/teleport-360-camera/id6476905405
